visual_findings: One cartoon face family: original, brighter background/color, grayscale, and 180-degree rotated image. Flip fixture is visually a half-turn, not an unrelated image.
Small four-image corpus does not qualify general photo, crop, alpha, multi-frame or HDR behavior.

findings.finding: imageHash returns Nothing for native status -1, initializes output storage to zero. All other native statuses treated as success; no generalized status validation or richer error reason.

imagesSimilar sequences both imageHash operations, then combines Maybe values; failure remains Nothing rather than false or a zero hash. Inclusive threshold is user supplied; negative/above64 thresholds not rejected.

PHash stores Word64 but toCPHash/fromCPHash use CULong constructor directly, and native calls use Ptr CULong / CULong rather than explicit unsigned long long. Correct width cannot be assumed on LLP64/32-bit C-long platforms. This is a source portability finding; no cross-platform compile, overwrite or native crash asserted.

Nine HUnit image cases check Nothing, Just golden hash and explicit Just True/False, including one/both missing files; two SmallCheck properties cover self distance and unequal hashes. Stronger success assertions than equality of arbitrary Either decode results. No all64-bit distance oracle, max-distance/symmetry property or ABI matrix.
DocTest invokes only src/Data/PHash.hs, not Image.hs where imageHash golden example is located. Main module examples cover Hamming calls.

CI GHC7.6.3/7.8.4/7.10.1 installs unpinned distro libphash0-dev, builds/tests/sdist. Native algorithm source not bundled. Root Main.hs imports PHash instead of exposed Data.PHash, not declared executable in cabal; standalone example not qualified.
GPL3 full text read; changelog records switch from MIT to GPL3 in0.0.2. No production source adopted.
